commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Ambitious effort from Cole Palmer (Chelsea). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
90+5' Referee Stuart Attwell points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) goes wild in celebration.
90+4' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Stuart Attwell makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+3' 2 - 2 That's a GOAL! The long throw is precisely headed on by Kristoffer Ajer to teammate Fabio Carvalho (Brentford), who coolly slots home from close range. It's now 2:2.
90+3' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
90+1' Tyrique George (Chelsea) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Stuart Attwell didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter will be replaced by Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
89' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
88' It will be a corner kick for Brentford.
88' A pass from Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.

85' 1 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Caoimhin Kelleher, so the score changes to 1:2.
83' Substitution. Michael Kayode is replaced by Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
83' Keith Andrews has decided to make a change. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) replaces Ethan Pinnock.
82' Yellow card! It's like Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Stuart Attwell agrees and books him.
81' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch for Joao Pedro.
77' Rico Henry (Brentford) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
77' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Caoimhin Kelleher is alert and denies him with a nice save.
73' Keith Andrews decides to make a substitution. Mathias Jensen will be replaced by Rico Henry (Brentford).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is replacing Igor Thiago.
72' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
72' Chelsea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
71' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
67' He should have scored! Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
65' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall.
64' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stuart Attwell ignores the protests.
63' The ball goes out for a corner. Brentford can continue in their attacking effort.
63' Kevin Schade (Brentford) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Robert Sanchez gets down to his right to keep it out.
61' 1 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer (Chelsea) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:1.
61' Reece James (Chelsea) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
60' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
59' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
56' Chelsea failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Here's the change. Jamie Gittens leaves the pitch and Cole Palmer (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
55' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Caoimhin Kelleher, who makes a comfortable save.
52' Kevin Schade (Brentford) commits a foul during an attacking move.
52' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

51' Tyrique George (Chelsea) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Caoimhin Kelleher is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
50' Tyrique George (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Brentford fail to score from a corner as Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) leaps to collect the ball.

48' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) is replaced by Marc Cucurella.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) comes off for Reece James.
46' Enzo Maresca makes a switch. Tyrique George is coming on in place of Facundo Buonanotte (Chelsea) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' This shall not pass! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

43' Caoimhin Kelleher makes a good save! Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
43' Kevin Schade (Brentford) brings his opponent down. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.

37' Kevin Schade (Brentford) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
35' 1 - 0 GOAL! Kevin Schade (Brentford) runs onto a pass from Jordan Henderson after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
33' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
30' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) for a tough tackle.
28' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
22' The game is interrupted as Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) is flagged offside.
22' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
22' Some neat passing and movement from Chelsea as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
20' A pass from Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) is intercepted by Caoimhin Kelleher and the move breaks down.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 31:69.
17' Chelsea work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

16' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
15' A clumsy foul by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle.
13' The linesman raises his flag. Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) is adjudged offside.
11' Michael Kayode (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle.
8' The foul by Igor Thiago (Brentford) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stuart Attwell.
7' Kevin Schade (Brentford) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
7' Brentford take a short corner kick.

7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Kevin Schade (Brentford) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
5' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
4' Igor Thiago (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
1' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
